business_scope.primary_industry_name: Programmatic Real-Time Ad Exchange and SSP Platform

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (República de Colombia) - unified national jurisdiction; reference registry: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental); unitary national system; commercial law codified in Código de Comercio (Decree 410 of 1971) and special S.A.S. regime under Law 1258 of 2008
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (investment chapter; in force May 15, 2012)
Colombia-Canada Free Trade Agreement (in force August 15, 2011)
Colombia-European Union Trade Agreement (investment provisions; provisional application since August 1, 2013)
Andean Community investment framework (Cartagena Agreement, Decision 292)
United States-Colombia Income Tax Convention (in force January 1, 2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Código de Comercio (Decree 410 of 1971, registry provisions); Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation); Law 1121 of 2006 and Law 1762 of 2015 (AML/CFT); Decree 1674 of 2016; Decree 830 of 2021; Law 2195 of 2022 (transparency and final beneficiary register); DIAN Resolution 164 of 2021 (Beneficiario Final rules and RUES filing); SuperSociedades Circular Externa 100-000005 of 2022 (SAGRILAFT and PEP); Decree 1074 of 2015 (single regulatory decree on commerce).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_threshold_note: DIAN Resolution 164 of 2021 sets 5% direct or indirect capital or voting rights for UBO identification; the 25% test applies only to entitlement to assets, profits or liquidation proceeds. A newly incorporated S.A.S. must file the Beneficiario Final form through RUES within one month of Chamber registration and update it annually in May.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of each foreign corporate shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or Chamber of Commerce in the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if issuing state is a Hague member) or Colombian consular legalization (non-Hague states), followed by official Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney executed by each non-resident shareholder in favor of the local incorporator and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization, followed by official Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copy of each non-resident individual shareholder and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization where signature or identity verification is required by the receiving Colombian notary or Chamber

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified banking reference and source-of-funds letter for each shareholder for AML/KYC file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization if required by Colombian corporate counsel or the notary receiving the S.A.S. document

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-closing and ongoing screening of all direct and indirect shareholders, directors, legal representatives and UBOs against: (i) OFAC SDN List; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iv) Colombian UIAF restrictive lists; (v) Colombian Lista Clinton (Decree 4448 of 2007); and (vi) PEP databases aligned with FATF Recommendation 12 and SuperSociedades Circular 100-000005 of 2022. Screening must be re-run at least annually and within five business days of any ownership change; results must be recorded in the company's SAGRILAFT file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social - RUES (www.rues.org.co), operated with the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (www.ccb.org.co) and accessed through the Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE, www.vue.gov.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish-alphabet characters; foreign words are admissible only if pronounceable and recognizable in Spanish and do not mislead the public. The name must be singular, distinctive, and not identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered trade name or company name; for an S.A.S., the name must end with the designation 'S.A.S.'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) with the same Chamber within 10 business days of service of the decision; if rejected, an appeal (recurso de apelación) may be lodged with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within five business days. A new homonimia request under a modified name may be filed immediately without prejudice. The reservation expires after 30 days and may be renewed by re-filing before expiration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual and coworking office addresses are accepted by Colombian Chambers for registration, provided the address is a physical location in Colombia where official correspondence, process service and Chamber notifications can be received and where the company's books and accounting records can be presented. The actual operational address (domicilio principal) must be declared to the Chamber and DIAN if different; a home-based address is acceptable for a fully digital AdTech platform, subject to municipal zoning and DIAN fiscal-address rules.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate in the first year: approximately 20-30% probability of an unannounced domicile verification visit (verificación domiciliaria) by the Chamber of Commerce and/or DIAN fiscal verification; for a fully digital SSP/DSP company with a documented virtual office and no physical inventory, the expected probability is approximately 10-15%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homonimia certificate through RUES / Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff (approx. COP 8,000); frequently bundled with the registration fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. by-laws (estatutos), incorporation minutes and shareholder consents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard S.A.S. package (USD 300-900)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized authentication of signatures on the private incorporation document
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff per signature (approx. COP 20,000 each)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign shareholder corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs or consulate of document origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government fee per document set; international average USD 100-150

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official Spanish translation of foreign documents (traductor oficial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate USD 30-60 per page; 2-3 pages typical
Free online process; professional handling included in legal counsel package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber registration of the S.A.S. (matrícula mercantil and inscription of the legal entity)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff in force (approx. COP 46,000 for minimum or no capital; increases proportionally with subscribed capital)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation after registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No state fee; professional handling included in legal counsel package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening plus AML/KYC file preparation for all shareholders and UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for individual and entity screening packages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered virtual office (first year) with mail handling and meeting room
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate USD 350-600 per year in Bogotá

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate domicile verification support and Chamber visit protocol assistance

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. law), Articles 1-5, 17, 27-29; Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (RUES registration); Ley 1429 de 2010 (business formalization); Superintendencia de Sociedades regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE); oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades, Bogotá D.C.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation deed) filed electronically through the VUE/RUES portal; a notarial escritura pública is mandatory only where the S.A.S. contributes real property rights at incorporation (Article 5(3), Ley 1258 de 2008).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required under Ley 1258 de 2008; capital is freely fixed in the bylaws and may be paid in whole or in part within two (2) years of subscription. No escrow or blocked account is mandated; however, founders and the legal representative remain jointly and severally liable for unpaid subscribed capital until fully paid.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — [S.A.S. COMPANY]. Adopted unanimously in Bogotá D.C., this day, by the founder/shareholders. 1. Share Subscription: The registered capital of COP 10,000,000, divided into 1,000 ordinary shares at a par value of COP 10,000, is fully subscribed and accepted. 2. Registered Office: The registered legal seat is fixed at [Calle 100 #19-45, Office 210, Bogotá D.C., Colombia] for all statutory notices and judicial service of process. 3. Officers: [Full Name], identified with Colombian ID [number], is appointed sole legal representative with broad powers under Law 1258 of 2008. 4. Delegation: The legal representative is authorized to file the incorporation deed, complete Chamber of Commerce registration, and obtain the RUT and operational licenses necessary for the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — RUES / Ventanilla Única Empresarial (vue.camarabogota.org) online window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit one primary and up to three alternative corporate names through the RUES online form. The system automatically compares the proposed name against registered legal entities and returns the homonimia (non-conflicting availability) certificate valid for 30 days. Accept the certified result in writing before drafting the bylaws.
required_dossiers: Solicitud de certificado de homonimia (signed online application)
Preliminary RUT data sheet of the founding shareholder
Identification document of the applicant legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected for exact or similar conflict, promptly file a renewed homonimia request using one of the pre-listed alternative names; no notarial cure is needed and the administrative query is cured by online resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Private Incorporation Deed (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Execution before the Cámara de Comercio officer or by private signature of all founders; notarization optional under Ley 1258 de 2008
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Spanish-language private deed containing full shareholder identification, precise corporate purpose (programmatic real-time ad exchange, SSP/DSP platform, data analytics), capital and payment-term clauses, registered address, legal representative powers, and audit/governance rules. Every founder signs the deed; electronic signature (e.firma) is accepted where all shares are subscribed and the capital payment term does not exceed two years.
required_dossiers: Documento privado de constitución (final bylaws text)
Certificado de homonimia (valid 30 days)
Copies of shareholders' national ID or passport for non-resident founders
Company preliminary RUT (Pre-RUT) confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry identifies formal defects in the deed, cure by executing a private amendment instrument (corrección) signed by all founders and refile electronically within the 60-day statutory term; substantial defects require a new deed and updated homonimia.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of the Deed and DIAN Pre-RUT Linking
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá RUES portal coordinated with DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the executed private deed to the RUES/VUE portal, pay the registration right (derecho de inscripción) via PSE, generate the RUES payment receipt, and link the company's Pre-RUT to obtain the provisional NIT (tax ID). Confirm the CIIU code 7310 (Publicidad) is mirrored in the economic activity section.
required_dossiers: Executed private deed (digitally signed PDF)
Homonimia certificate
PSE payment receipt of the registration tariff
DIAN Pre-RUT declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN questions the tax classification or the CIIU code, file an electronic corrective sworn statement re-validating activity 7310; if the chamber rejects the filing, resubmit the corrected documents in the same file number without re-execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Certification (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Mercantil section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the deed is approved, obtain the official certificate of existence and legal representation. Verify that the legal representative's powers, corporate purpose, address, and the S.A.S. incorporation are correctly transcribed and that the registry has electronically notified the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
required_dossiers: Approved registration order from RUES
Certificado de existencia y representación legal (chamber-issued)
Payment confirmation of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any transcription discrepancy (name, capital, address) is cured by submitting an online registry-correction request to the chamber supported by a certified copy of the relevant bylaw clause; correction is effected within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT Registration and E-Invoicing Configuration at DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — go.dian.gov.co electronic services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access DIAN's online platform, finalize the definitive RUT (Formulario 3501) with registered address, legal representative data, and CIIU 7310; select the general or simplified VAT regime as applicable, and activate electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) with the required invoice software certification and fiscal operator registration.
required_dossiers: Certificado de existencia y representación legal
Definitive RUT (Formulario 3501)
Legal representative national ID
Registered office lease or utilities proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN assigns an incorrect tax regime, file a derecho de petición under C.P.A.C.A. 1437 of 2011 with the bylaws and correction of the economic activity; e-invoicing activation delays are cured by requesting expedited resolution through the DIAN 'Mi Dian' virtual office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Security Enrollment, Bank Account Opening, and Urban Zoning Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Social security aggregators (e.g., SURA, Colpensiones), commercial banks with SWIFT/ACH rails, and Curaduría Urbana / local planning authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as employer with social security operators using the definitive NIT; open a corporate multi-currency account (COP/USD) enabling SWIFT wire and ACH-Direct transfers for programmatic payment rails; obtain the certificate of land use (certificado de uso del suelo) confirming office-compatible zoning for the registered address.
required_dossiers: Company NIT and definitive RUT
Certificado de existencia y representación legal
Legal representative ID and beneficial ownership statement
Lease contract and zoning certificate of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank onboarding is delayed by AML screening, provide the chamber certificate, tax standing certificate, and notarized beneficial ownership declaration; if zoning denies office use, relocate to a compatible commercial zone and file the address amendment in RUES before completing labor enrollment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial licensing board has jurisdiction over software-based programmatic advertising; the residual digital-services authority (MinTIC) does not require a permit for non-telecom AdTech exchange platforms.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: N/A — no statutory operating or manufacturing license is required for ISIC 7310 digital advertising and SSP/DSP software services; only generic mercantile and tax registrations apply.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de Cundinamarca (CAR) / Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based, zero-discharge software activity is not listed under Decree 1076 of 2015; no EIA report or environmental diagnosis (DAA) registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Indirect municipal compliance only: sanitary wastewater discharge to the municipal sewer per Resolution 0631 of 2015; electronic-waste handling per Resolution 1362 of 2007; standby VOC thresholds apply solely to any printing or hardware maintenance, not to cloud-based operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos for the registered office; land-use and structural load clearance issued by the Curaduría Urbana; occupational health and safety system (SG-SST) per Decreto 1072 of 2015 and Resolución 0312 of 2019 for workplaces with ten or more employees; computer-workstation ergonomic and medical clearance for software personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; electronic services and registration through MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) at https://muisca.dian.gov.co; integrated foreign trade and customs platform: SISCOSEX.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An S.A.S. must complete, before any taxable activity: (1) execution of the constitutive private document recorded with the Cámara de Comercio of the registered seat (no minimum capital; 100% foreign ownership is permitted); (2) RUT registration (Registro Único Tributario) before DIAN through MUISCA, performed by the legal representative under digital certificate or via a notarized power of attorney for non-resident incorporators; (3) automatic issuance of the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) embedded in the RUT; (4) selection of tax attributes: IVA responsible person, exporter of services status, e-invoicing profile, and SIMPLE regime election if applicable; (5) activation of electronic invoicing software with an authorized technology operator. Standard processing takes 3 to 10 business days; the legal representative must be a natural person, though not necessarily a Colombian national, and non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of the equity with no local residency or minimum capital requirement.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the S.A.S. is a Colombian tax resident (place of effective management criterion) taxable on worldwide income (renta de fuente nacional y extranjera) at the general CIT rate of 35% for tax years 2023-2025 and 30% from tax year 2026 (Law 2277 of 2022). No pass-through or partnership classification is available; dividends paid to non-resident shareholders are subject to 10% dividend withholding tax. Optional Tax_Exempt_Zone status (single-user Zona Franca) may be authorized for qualifying software/digital service exporters, applying a 20% CIT rate and 0% VAT on exports. Territorial_Scope rules apply only to non-resident digital service providers invoicing Colombian clients, not to the resident exporter.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists. Available mechanisms: (a) Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) - optional consolidated regime for entities with prior-year gross income below 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 164.7 million for 2024) satisfying asset and headcount tests, replacing CIT, VAT (in a simplified form), and ICA; technology/ad services are assigned specific aggregate rate bands (approximately 3%-7%); (b) Zona Franca Permanente Especial (single-user zone) - optional 20% CIT and 0% VAT for exported services under government authorization; (c) Export-services zero-rating under Art. 481 ET must be affirmatively flagged in the periodic Form 300; (d) Hybrid mismatch rules under Decree 1625 of 2016 and Law 2277 of 2022 restrict deductions on payments to related non-residents producing mismatch outcomes; no elective increases in hybrid deductions are permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas) regulated by Estatuto Tributario Arts. 420-503, Law 1819 of 2016, and Decree 1625 of 2016; supplementary national consumption/IVA regime applies to digital services acquired by Colombian recipients from foreign providers at the 19% rate, paid through the local buyer's Form 300.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary nexus threshold for legal entities: any S.A.S. selling taxable services or goods is a mandatory IVA responsible taxpayer irrespective of turnover. The de minimis exception (No Responsable) is reserved to natural persons with gross income below 3,500 UVT (COP 164,727,500 for 2024; 3,500 UVT = COP 174,296,500 for 2025) and is not available to corporations. SIMPLE regime access likewise requires prior-year gross income below 3,500 UVT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing under DIAN Resolution 165 of 2023: all sales, including export-service sales, must be issued through an authorized technology operator (Proveedor Tecnológico) using web-service APIs (XML/JSON) and transmitted to DIAN for real-time validation (validacion previa) before issuance to the customer. Each invoice must contain the unique electronic billing code (CUFE) and a scannable 2D/QR code with the fiscal hash; export invoices use the export modality. Ancillary mandated documents: electronic payroll notes (nomina electronica), document soporte for acquisitions from non-invoicing suppliers, and SISCOSEX filings for foreign-trade transactions. Failure to obtain DIAN validation invalidates the invoice, denies input VAT credits for the recipient, and triggers account suspension and penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Art. 481 ET and Decree 1625/2016, a service qualifies for the 0% export VAT rate if: (i) the recipient is a non-resident person or entity without tax domicile in Colombia; (ii) the service is used or exploited exclusively outside Colombia, with no economic link to Colombian-source activities; (iii) the consideration is paid in freely convertible foreign currency, or the contract documents foreign-source payment; and (iv) the exporter maintains contemporaneous documentary evidence. DIAN doctrine (e.g., Concept 1089 of 2019) recognizes programmatic advertising intermediation, SSP platform access, and ad-auction/logistics services as qualifying export services when the advertising inventory, end-users, and final beneficiaries are located abroad. Input VAT on costs attributable to zero-rated exports (cloud infrastructure, data feeds, hosting) is creditable and periodically refundable through Form 300; services that partially benefit Colombian advertisers or local traffic must be apportioned, with the domestic portion taxed at 19%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Declaration of Services (Declaracion de Exportacion de Servicios) filed through SISCOSEX and endorsed by DIAN (or the standard DEX customs export declaration if tangible media/equipment is included)
Electronic export invoice with DIAN-validated CUFE and export modality denomination
Signed commercial agreement with the non-resident counterparty specifying jurisdiction, foreign use, and delivery scope of the programmatic ad-exchange/SSP services
Inward foreign-exchange settlement certificate (Declaracion de Cambio) issued by an authorized Colombian intermediary bank (IME) evidencing receipt and sale of the foreign currency proceeds

Technical delivery evidence: programmatic auction logs, bid requests/responses, SSP transaction reports, IP-geolocation and traffic-origin reports demonstrating consumption of the services exclusively abroad
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-validates zero-rated export claims against SISCOSEX filings, bank FOREX records, contract terms, and platform usage logs. If exclusive foreign use is not proven, the full invoice value is reassessed at 19% VAT, plus moratory interest at the statutory monthly rate (current reference banking interest rate increased by 50%, certified monthly) and the inaccuracy penalty equal to 100% of the tax difference under Art. 648 ET, escalated to 200% where simulated transactions, non-existent export documentation, or fictitious invoicing are found. Fictitious export arrangements expose the entity and its legal representatives to criminal tax evasion prosecution under Law 1819 of 2016 (imprisonment up to 9 years and substantial fines), cancellation of exporter status, revocation of VAT refund certificates, and clawback of all refunds received within the general 5-year limitation period, extendable to 15 years where returns were not filed or fraud is proven.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) and the Comisión de Cambio (Foreign Exchange Commission), administered operationally by the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for exchange control registration and verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a managed floating exchange rate regime with full convertibility on the current account and a liberalized but controlled capital account. Non-residents may freely invest in Colombian entities, including SAS corporations, subject to registration with the Central Bank's foreign exchange office (Banco de la República) via the Declaración de Cambio (foreign exchange declaration). Profit remittances (dividends) to non-resident shareholders require prior registration of the foreign investment with Banco de la República; once registered, remittances are permitted without prior approval, but all transactions must be channeled through authorized intermediaries (intermediarios del mercado cambiario). Capital account transactions, including inbound capital contributions exceeding USD 10,000 equivalent, must be reported within statutory deadlines; outbound capital repatriation of registered investments is free, but unregistered investments face restrictions and penalties. The Colombian peso (COP) is not an internationally traded hard currency; practical convertibility depends on the commercial banking system's access to offshore correspondent banking and the availability of US dollars in the local interbank market.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia applies mandatory surrender requirements for export proceeds deriving from sales of goods and certain services, including software development and digital advertising services, to the extent classified as exports under Article 89 of Decree 2245 of 2017 and Resolution 1 of 2018. Under the current regime (Regimen Cambiario, Decreto 1068 de 2015, Libro 12), export proceeds must be surrendered to the domestic foreign exchange market within the term established by the Central Bank: for services, the term is generally six months from the date of issuance of the export declaration or invoice, but extendable to 12 months for software and technology-related services if properly justified and reported. The mandatory conversion ratio is 100% of the FOB value of the export, to be negotiated through an authorized foreign exchange intermediary (bank or financial corporation) to Colombian pesos, unless the exporter obtains prior authorization from the Central Bank to maintain foreign currency in accounts abroad or in local foreign currency accounts (cuentas de compensación) under Article 413 of Decree 1068. Non-surrender triggers exchange penalty fines under Articles 24 and 25 of Law 9 of 1991, as amended, up to 200% of the unreported amount. In practice, the Medellín and Bogotá chambers of commerce and DIAN accept programmatic advertising services as exporting services if the contract, invoice, and SWIFT payment trail evidence the provision from Colombia.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore EMIs as primary operating accounts. Colombian exchange control law requires all foreign currency transactions related to exports and capital investments to be channeled through authorized local intermediaries (bancos comerciales). Offshore EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) cannot act as the mandatory intermediary for surrender of export proceeds nor provide a local USD/COP settlement account that satisfies DIAN and Banco de la República reporting. They may be used only as auxiliary collection tools for inbound receipts from foreign ad counterparties, provided funds are promptly repatriated to a local authorized bank account and declared in the Declaración de Cambio. Legal constraint: Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83 of Banco de la República requires all exchange transactions to be reported by the authorized intermediary; an offshore EMI is not a permitted intermediary. Defense: use local licensed fintechs with foreign exchange authorization, such as Nequi (with Bancolombia) or Movii, strictly for domestic disbursements, never for cross-border settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the legal representative (director) and at least one substantial shareholder is required at the bank branch for account opening. While some tier-1 banks offer remote video verification for existing clients or high-net-worth individuals, a newly formed SAS with non-resident directors must attend an in-person interview at the designated corporate banking center in Bogotá, Medellín, or Cali. The physical interview serves to verify identity, validate the commercial substance of the programmatic advertising platform, and review the corporate purpose and expected transaction flows. For accounts with a capital injection exceeding USD 50,000 or expected monthly USD turnovers above USD 100,000, banks additionally require a visit of the bank's compliance officer to the registered office or a virtual site visit with ledger review, depending on the bank's overall risk appetite. Remote opening for a 100% non-resident owned entity is generally not permitted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors/shareholders with no Colombian tax ID (NIT) or no local economic nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificates of incorporation from the foreign parent, passports and visa documentation for directors, audited financial statements of the foreign parent, proof of ownership chain, and a board resolution authorizing the local SAS to open the account and specifying the beneficial ownership structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High cross-border transaction volume with counterparties in jurisdictions perceived as low-corruption-risk but lacking local exchange regulations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed advertising service agreements (SSP/ad exchange contracts), commercial invoices with ISIC 7310 description, and a statement of beneficial ownership for each counterparty, plus a business rationale report confirming that all services are rendered from Colombia and that funds are for genuine commercial activities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid in-and-out flows (capital injection followed immediately by disbursements to foreign ad inventory providers)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury policy document setting out sequential fund usage rules, cash flow projections for the first 12 months, and a commitment letter to maintain trailing 12-month statements for spot audit. Provide proof of the underlying contracts that require prepayments to media suppliers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mixed USD-COP account operations with unregistered capital increases
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign investment registration certificate (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales) issued by Banco de la República, and the Formulario No. 11 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales) evidencing the inbound funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of shared offices or virtual workspace as the registered address
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for a physical office space in Colombia, utility bills, photographs of the premises with signage, and an operational substance description detailing the development team's daily presence and equipment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections into the CO_SAS entity must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 to a local account held with an authorized Colombian bank (e.g., Bancolombia). The remitting bank should use the appropriate purpose code as per Banco de la República's exchange classification: for foreign direct investment in a SAS, the declaration code is 'STR-US' or 'US-DOC' for capital registerable as a financial loan; for equity, use the code '1401' (private non-financial sector foreign direct investment) or the generic 'Inversión directa' under Formulario 11. The physical wire must include the company's NIT number, the unique exchange registration number (código del intermediario), and the clause 'Para trámite de Declaración de Cambio No. 11'. Pre-registration with the local bank's foreign exchange desk is mandatory for amounts over USD 10,000; the bank will issue a draft foreign exchange declaration that must be validated and presented to Banco de la República within the same business week. For capital contributions in excess of USD 500,000, a preliminary letter of intent must be filed with the Central Bank's statistics department to obtain a provisional investment registration ID.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for advertising inventory purchases, media buys, and third-party technology costs (DSP-to-SSP payments, bidder fees, server rentals) must be executed via SWIFT MT103 (or local equivalent using CUD - Código Único de Desembolso) from the company's USD-denominated operational account. For payments to domestic Colombian suppliers, use the ACH/COP clearing system (CENIT operated by ACH Colombia). For cross-border commercial transactions exceeding USD 50,000 per transaction, the Colombian exporter/importer must use the 'Declaración de Cambio' through the intermediary bank, attaching the commercial invoice, proof of service origin, and indication of the purpose code. For letter of credit settlements, the Colombian bank will issue a Commercial LC (documentary credit) subject to UCP 600; however, for low-risk software services, a standard SWIFT wire or irrevocable LC at sight is preferred. All outbound foreign payments are subject to the 0.4% (GMF - Gravamen al Movimiento Financiero) financial transactions tax unless waived under certain technology export incentive programs (Law 1819 of 2016), and must be reported individually to DIAN under taxpayer reporting requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/COP transacted with local authorized banks (e.g., Bancolombia, BBVA Colombia) only for hedging real commercial exposure under a current account or capital account obligation; no speculative positions.

Forward contracts (Forwards de Tasa de Cambio) with physical settlement in COP/USD, requiring an underlying export contract or import obligation and registration with the Central Bank's foreign exchange desk.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between COP and USD for balance-sheet hedging of the foreign investment liability or long-term receivables, subject to Banco de la República's prior notification and authorization for tenors above one year.
FX options (European-style) on USD/COP, permitted for hedging the conversion of export proceeds receivables, but must be executed solely through the authorized local market.
Commodity or crypto-linked derivatives are strictly prohibited for hedging purposes; only plain-vanilla instruments referencing the official TRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado) are allowed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of mercantile registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) having territorial jurisdiction over the S.A.S. registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year; renewal period opens January 1
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers default interest and administrative enforcement; continued non-renewal can lead to fines by the Superintendencia de Sociedades and involuntary cancellation of the mercantile registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual financial statements (Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio in the S.A.S. jurisdiction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the shareholders' meeting approving the financial statements; the meeting must occur by March 31, so effective deadline is April 30 following the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit may incur fines from the Superintendencia de Sociedades and restrictions on legal representation or registration of new corporate acts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and update of beneficial owners (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in accordance with the corporate income tax due date calendar, generally between April 9 and April 30 of each year; any change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be reported within 30 calendar days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance or inaccurate information is punishable with fines up to 1,800 UVT (approx. USD 1,400) per requirement, plus tax enforcement and compulsory sanction proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory audit or revisor fiscal is mandatory when the S.A.S. has total assets or gross income exceeding 30,000 SMLMV (for 2024, approx. COP 39,000,000,000 or USD 10,000,000); also required where more than 30% of clients require audited financial statements or when mandated by the bylaws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by IASB or IFRS for SMEs, as applicable under Colombia's Grupo 1, 2, or 3 classification established by Law 1314 of 2009 and Decree 2483 of 2018; local GAAP does not apply to S.A.S. financial reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. legal representative must annually certify and submit the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales to DIAN. Any direct or indirect shareholding transfer that modifies ultimate beneficial ownership requires an updated UBO disclosure within 30 calendar days; no additional annual shareholders' re-filing is required beyond the income-tax-linked confirmation when shareholding structure remains unchanged.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Junta Directiva or equivalent board register)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea y/o Junta Directiva)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (tarifa general del impuesto sobre la renta, Article 240 E.T., as amended by Law 2277/2022; rate in force for tax year 2023 and thereafter)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 35% liability, mitigated by: (i) 'orange economy' exemption available only to S.A.S. incorporated before 1 Jan 2023 that qualified for the 0% rate during their first 5 fiscal years; (ii) 100% tax deduction for investments in software research, technological development and innovation projects registered with the Ministry of Science (Art. 158-1 E.T.), with an optional incremental 25% deduction for seed-stage projects; (iii) 100% deduction for investment in non-conventional renewable energy production (Law 1715/2014); (iv) VAT exemption at 0% for exported digital services and software; (v) reduced CIT base via accelerated depreciation on fixed assets acquired between 2020-2025.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no statutory expiration under Art. 147 E.T.; for losses generated in tax year 2023 onwards, the annual offset is capped at 50% of the ordinary net taxable income of the compensation year)
